messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer-77 says their Prom/Grafana stopped showing metrics after moving to the Private VPC yesterday. No ingests visible in our sideband. Can someone point me to the quick checks?

kevin: Do we have their remote_write/OTLP endpoint details? Most likely either firewall/NAT or their remote_write target is misconfigured.

sam: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm customer remote_write target at customer-prom:9090 or remote endpoint; 2) Check firewall allows outbound to our ingest (443/4317 for OTLP/gRPC); 3) Verify NAT mapping so return traffic reaches their collector.

maria: They pasted this in support ticket: `https://prom.customer-77.vpc.internal/api/v1/write` and said they switched to an OTLP collector in front of Prom. No error logs on their side (they say).

kevin: If they're using an OTLP collector in front of Prom, ensure the collector forwards to our OTLP ingest on 4317 (gRPC) or 55681. Also ensure TLS is correct and they include the bearer token header.

jia: I asked for their OTEL config and they returned this snippet. Sharing for quick eyeball:

```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
exporters:
  otlphttp/ri:
    endpoint: "https://ingest.redwood-inference.private/customer-77/otlp"
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer <redacted>"
service:
  pipelines:
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlphttp/ri]
```

kevin: That exporter endpoint looks right. Two quick things to check on their side: 1) TLS verification — if they have a proxy that rewrites certs, gRPC will fail silently; 2) Ensure the header name matches our ingress (some OTEL configs use `authorization` lowercase).

obs-bot: Alert: `prom_remote_write_down_customer77` fired (no samples for 24h). Related dashboards: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal/d/customer-77/overview

sam: Also check our side for dropped connections: `nginx-ingest` logs show many `502` for that tenant in the last 12h — could be upstream TLS handshake failures.

maria: Thanks. Can someone run a tcpdump on the VPC NAT gateway to confirm whether connections from their collector reach our ingest? If we see SYN/ACK then it's on our TLS/auth side.

kevin: I can run the NAT capture. Also will tail `nginx-ingest` and `ingest-gw` logs. If we see `tls: unknown certificate` or `received http2 error code: PROTOCOL_ERROR` that's a hint.

jia: I asked the customer to switch to `curl -v --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://ingest.redwood-inference.private/customer-77/otlp/v1/metrics` from their collector host to validate network/TLS. If that fails, they capture `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect ingest.redwood-inference.private:443` and send output.

maria: Can we also relax the alert threshold for this alert to avoid noisy pages while we investigate (it's firing repeatedly)? Suggested: turn the alert into a P0->P1 for this customer for the next 6 hours.

kevin: I can mute/adjust it in the alert manager for customer-77 channel for 6h. Leaving a note in the ticket.

sam: Final note — if we confirm collector -> ingest reaches our edge but auth fails, we should temporarily allow token in `x-api-key` header (backwards compat) for this tenant while they rotate. I'll open a small rollout PR.

maria: Awesome. Assigning ticket #INC-2026 to kevin/sam. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:

kevin: Started NAT tcpdump (pid 4523). Will paste results in ~15m.

jia: Customer ran `curl` — got `403` with body `{"error":"invalid token"}`. They sent the curl output to support.

maria: Good find. So network is fine. It'll be token/auth mismatch. Sam — please proceed with the temporary header fallback PR and coordinate token rotation with the customer.

sam: On it. PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ingest-config/pulls/152 (small change to accept `x-api-key` for tenant `customer-77` for 6h).

maria: Thanks everyone — closing this thread once PR is merged and customer confirms metrics are flowing again.
